title: Great experience
text: Very pleasant and interesting tour. Many thanks to Ramon, who is very well-informed with this local area and all the spiecies. Hope to see and take photos of Iberian Magpie next time.
author: borara_o

title: Magnificent Nature
text: Our tour guide, Jose, was excellent. He was very informative and his photography is magnificent. He sent us beautiful photos of the birds, the deer, the lynx and the fox we were thrilled to see. We also really enjoyed the nature walk through the forest.
author: lynda_k

title: Donana Park - a Great Experience
text: Wonderful, thoughtful guide showed us this beautiful, environmentally and culturally important area. The birds were fantastic to watch, El Rocio getting ready for this year’s pilgrimage and a walk on the beach to finish. Fantastic day out
author: Marc_H

title: Very knowledgeable guide
text: Very knowledgeable guide an expert on birds. Was a pleasure to listen and learn from him. The tour was more than expected
author: Mary R

text: I was able to see beautiful wildlife and our guide was very knowledgeable! I would recommend this tour to all nature lovers
author: Lucas_V

title: Beautiful national park
text: Seeing deer and birds in their natural habitat, the old town with horses, the sand dune walk, the forest walk
author: Greg_K

title: Great diversity
text: We saw diverse landscape and vegetation, beautiful birds. Our guide, Ramón knew all the bird species and gave us valuable information about the history, present situation and conservation efforts of the park. He was enthusiastic and  friendly, I definitely suggest him and the tour as well.
author: Rebeka_S

title: Relaxing day in PN Donana
text: We had a good day with Miguel, saw a lynx early on and had plenty of free time and flexibility during the day.
author: davidbE3645WF

title: Excellent day at Donana
text: Very unique natural reserve and we enjoyed spotting the wildlife with extremely able guides. We do appreciate the friendly and informative approach of Teresa who was also flexible to see that everyone in the trip was satisfied.
author: Pioneer5984

title: Not worth the money
text: The drive through the little hamlet of San Rosario was great but the National park disappointing as there was nothing to see but trees and scrub. It was very dry after a hot summer and on reaching the beach found the guide taking us on a “short” walk up a small dune to a level boardwalk lookout but then he decided to take us on a trek through the hot sandy dunes that toon over an hour to just see sand and scrubby trees.
